svg.title: Multiscale physical hierarchy for the consciousness bridge program
svg.desc: Master figure connecting microscopic physical dynamics, mesoscopic biological and engineered networks, certified moving subsystems from Spatiotemporal Observer Mathematics, intervention-resolved causal structure, temporal composition and scale theorems, empirical measurements, and the open mathematical consciousness bridge.
svg.text: Multiscale Physical Hierarchy of the Research Program
From physical dynamics to measurable causal organization, with scale, uncertainty, and the physical-to-experiential bridge kept mathematically distinct.

g.text: 1. Microscopic / local physical dynamics
dXt = f(Xt,ut) dt + G(Xt,ut) dWt
state variables • forces / transitions • noise • energy exchange
Physics lineage: stochastic dynamics, statistical mechanics, nonequilibrium thermodynamics
2. Cellular, neural, or engineered network state
Xt+Δt ∼ KΔt( · | Xt,ut )
spiking / field / physiological / controller variables at a declared resolution
Scale choice is explicit; P17 proves that coarse-graining can erase distinctions.
3. Dynamically distinguished moving subsystem
integration • insulation • persistence • transport • identifiability
Foundation: Spatiotemporal Observer Mathematics
The output is a certified physical subsystem, not an experiential conclusion.
4. Intervention-resolved causal structure
Pᵤ,τ(p) = ℒ(Yᵛ(t + τ) | do(u), p)
response geometry G • directed influence A • partition irreducibility K
Fcausal(p) = [V,Up,T,Gp,Ap,Kp]≅
P11-P13: construction + component-level minimality and irredundancy audits

svg.text: MATHEMATICAL STRUCTURE ACROSS TIME, COMPOSITION, AND SCALE

g.text: Temporal continuation
D̄([c],[c′]) = minh∈H D(c,hc′)
P14-P15: representation-invariant temporal paths + finite-error certification
Composition and coupling
PAB = PA ⊗ PB under declared independence
χAB = sup ‖PAB − PA⊗PB‖TV
P16: exact null model for independent composition and measurable coupling defect
Scale change and coarse-graining
‖C#P − C#Q‖TV ≤ ‖P − Q‖TV
bijective relabeling preserves distance; many-to-one maps can collapse it to zero
P17: data-processing contraction and exact non-recoverability witnesses
Finite-data observability
γS > 4ε
measurement error, sample complexity, protocol selection, and recoverability
P7-P10 and P15: population statements are separated from certified finite-data claims.
Measured state and perturbation evidence
EEG / MEG / fMRI / intracranial signals / physiology / behavior
wakefulness • dreaming • anesthesia • disorders of consciousness
Key empirical lineage: Casali; Sarasso; Siclari; Claassen; Luppi and collaborators
Measurements constrain theory; they do not define the experiential target by themselves.
Extreme-environment robustness
sleep / circadian disruption • isolation • workload • radiation • altered gravity
tests stability of measurement and state-estimation models under operational stress
NASA Human Research Program is used here as an application and validation domain.
Competing bridge theories
IIT • GNWT • recurrent processing • higher-order • predictive / representational families
𝔗j = (Fj, Bj, Mj, Πj)
P2-P6 provide common identifiability, discrimination, sufficiency, and completeness tests.
Open mathematical consciousness bridge
B̄ : QP → QE
Target: identify an independently physical signature whose equivalence classes match a formally justified experiential equivalence.
The bridge remains a distinct theorem-and-evidence problem, not a relabeling of complexity, integration, recurrence, or causal structure.

svg.text: Shannon — information theory • Amari — information geometry • Landauer / Seifert — thermodynamics of information • Pearl — intervention • Tegmark — physical factorization

Empirical consciousness interface: Tononi / IIT literature, Casali perturbational complexity, Luppi information integration, adversarial theory testing, and state-dissociation studies. Full role-aware citations are maintained in the repository bibliographies.
